notes.title: What's being worked on in Core Lords?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A bit longer on the update than I would usually like, got covid again this month (-.-). That and my wife is very very very pregnant with our first, lots to prepare!

So outside of the usual bug fixing, optimizing and tweaking, here is what is being worked on for Core Lords: [b]A new biome and level![/b]

[h2]The Canyon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869109/ab414523fae87ec684ef61495212b2f0c28b2f1f.png[/img]
A gloomy fog and and driving rain hangs over this imposing gash in the earth. Slippery rocks and ledges create a sweaty-palmed climb to a great danger. An opportunity for more environmental puzzles, battles and even new powers await!


[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869109/151297cf64f49ed2b9ac3b119279292cadd66505.png[/img]
A strange corruption has descended upon the land, and the canyon and it's local inhabitants are not immune. The first of the new enemy types for canyon zone, these little guys can really overwhelm in groups!


[h2]Building a boss arena and... well the boss.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869109/f9c9e2018dbace56c739086ffe6cc88d853ac4fe.png[/img]
A messy sketch of what is being worked on in terms of a boss arena and hints at what the boss could be. I really hope to develop the world through environmental story telling - any theories?


All very work-in-progress, and as usual, let me know of any feedback/ideas you have!

Cheers,
Chris

notes.title: Core Lords - Demo Update (v1.1)
notes.content:
Hi all,

A (long overdue) update to the demo has been released.

A huge list of updates, bugs fixes, QoL changes have been worked on, and I will be unable to list them all, but some major changes are as follows:

[b]GAMEPLAY/AI[/b]
[list]
[*] More enemy behavior such as strafing, keeping distance and better line of sight calculations
[*] Vastly improved AI actions and decision making (though still needs work!)
[*] Enemy drops (combat drops and permanent upgrades)
[*] Improved jumping and falling behaviour
[/list]

[b]TUTORIAL STORY[/b]
[list]
[*] A huge amount of bug fixes
[*] Clearer tutorial hints
[*] Balanced delays and pacing of tutorial information
[*] Visual and camera tweaks
[*] Fixes for puzzles
[/list]

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Visual indication of enemy and player health and action points in combat
[*] More indicators and affordance for what actions you take will result in, especially with Core interactions
[*] Smoother movement behavior, such as better navmesh, hold-to-move and click-to-move, move-to and climb etc.
[/list]

[b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b]
[list]
[*] Better interaction with water and lava
[*] Better procedural generation for Quick Battle
[*] Gaps, holes and other kinds of collider fixes
[*] Lots of general bug fixes
[/list]

[b]ANIMATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Smoother animations, especially with running and other movement (less janky and staggered, but still working on it)
[*] New animations for the player character
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Cleaner and more consistent design
[*] UI interaction fixes, such as toggling and buttons
[*] General visual UI improvements and fixes
[/list]

[b]VFX/SFX[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements and adjustments to visual and sound effects, such as performance tweaks, visual clarity and consistency
[/list]


If you give the demo a go, please let me know what you think!

Cheers, 
Chris

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869109/6c15773edd374c534034264912c5b219f97c6aa8.png[/img]

The Core Lords Demo is now playable for everyone - [b]PLAY IT FREE NOW![/b] :D

All you need to do is to go to the game's Steam page and press the green button "Download Core Lords Demo" to start playing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357850/Core_Lords/

Remember to add the game to your wishlist as well!

I’m so excited for you to experience Core Lords and it would help greatly if you could share your first impressions of the Demo on all community and social media channels that you are active on with a link to the Steam page.

Also, tell your friends and family about it and get them to play the demo, talk about Core Lords and mention it everywhere you can. Thank you for any support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869109/20d05fc8a566989d993900554259302a7a570564.gif[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE DEMO[/b][/h3]

The demo will give a taste of the game, having a short intro to the story, world and mechanics. Roughly 30-40 minutes of play.

You will also be able to jump into quick battles where you can play around with 2 out of the 4 Core powers that will be available in the game (Stone/Wind), so you can get a feel for the battle mechanics, more powerful enemies and the destructible world.

Heads up: The game is still fresh and will have bugs and missing quality-of-life features.


[h3][b]DEMO FEEDBACK AND BUG REPORTING[/b][/h3]

Heading over to the discord to report any bugs or give feedback would be greatly appreciated! I will be around in Discord to answer questions as much as I can.

[b][url=http://discord.gg/XZX3PEBqQD]DISCORD[/url][/b]

Thanks again and I hope to hear from you all soon!

Cheers,
Chris
